sources.title: Quazim0t0 (Dean Byrne) - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Attaching the AMOE to any model I've tried has created expanded or improved behavioral accumulations. They do have downsides but their upsides are very experimentally exciting. I've distilled multiple vits, multiple berts, and have begun distilling berts into AlephLM structures successfully. This is overall very exciting for me.
